title: Wan 2.2 5B, node by node, and how it differs from the 14B pair

questions.q: Why does the 14B route have four times the tokens of 5B at the same picture size?
options: Its VAE compresses 8x in space where 5B's compresses 16x, and both use the same 2 x 2 patch
questions.answer: Its VAE compresses 8x in space where 5B's compresses 16x, and both use the same 2 x 2 patch
questions.why: Each side of the latent grid doubles, so positions multiply by 4. Layers and channels don't change the token count.

questions.q: How does 5B do image to video with the same model as text to video?
options: Wan22ImageToVideoLatent encodes the start image into the first latent frames and masks them, and each frame gets its own timestep
It loads a second image model
It repeats the image on every frame
questions.answer: Wan22ImageToVideoLatent encodes the start image into the first latent frames and masks them, and each frame gets its own timestep
questions.why: The node writes the encoded image and a noise_mask, and WAN22.process_timestep turns the mask into per-frame timesteps.

questions.q: What does boundary 0.875 mean in Wan's 14B config?
options: Steps at high noise use the high-noise model, and it hands over to the low-noise model past that point
The VAE switches at that point
questions.answer: Steps at high noise use the high-noise model, and it hands over to the low-noise model past that point
questions.why: The config names a low noise and a high noise checkpoint, and the sampler picks one per step by that boundary. 5B has no boundary.

questions.q: You set batch_size 4 on Wan22ImageToVideoLatent with no start image. How many videos come out?
options: 1, since that branch makes a latent with a batch of 1
questions.answer: 1, since that branch makes a latent with a batch of 1
questions.why: The latent is created with first dimension 1, and batch_size is used only when start_image is given.

questions.q: Our graph has shift 8 and 20 steps. What does Wan's 5B config say?
questions.why: wan_ti2v_5B.py sets sample_shift 5.0 and sample_steps 50. 12 and 40 belong to the 14B config.
